summary.content:
Today's selection covers 87 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Powerful A.I. Super PACs Duel Over the Midterms: ‘This Is a War’
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Charter Communications data breach affects 4.9 million accounts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 17 articles published in the last 24 hours
